## Substantive differences

- **A mandatory chloride test was added in version B.** Version B requires: “**Chloride on every AF-12 batch, max 400 ppm (see CR-1996-005)**.” This introduces:
  - a new quality-control obligation;
  - application specifically to **every AF-12 batch**;
  - a maximum permitted chloride level of **400 ppm**;
  - a reference to **CR-1996-005**.
- **The document revision and effective date changed** from “**Rev 1, effective 10/01/1994**” in A to “**Rev 2, effective 12/02/1996**” in B.
- The change note was updated from “**QC release plan, first controlled issue**” to “**Added chloride test on AF-12 (CR-1996-005)**,” reflecting the new requirement.
- The archive status is unchanged: both documents are marked “**SUPERSEDED ARCHIVE COPY**.”

## Additions in B

- New step 3: “**Chloride on every AF-12 batch, max 400 ppm (see CR-1996-005).**”
- The corresponding change note: “**Added chloride test on AF-12 (CR-1996-005).**”
- New revision metadata: “**Rev 2**” and effective date “**12 February 1996**.”

## Removals relative to A

- No quality-control step or requirement from version A was removed.
- The original steps remain in B:
  - viscosity;
  - fineness of grind;
  - retention of a 0.5 L sample for one year;
  - 60° gloss;
  - odour check.
- The phrase “**first controlled issue**” was removed from the change note and replaced with the description of the chloride-test addition.

## Reformulations

- The original steps were renumbered from 1–5 to 1–6 because the chloride test was inserted as new step 3.
- The revision and date lines were updated to reflect the newer controlled issue.
- The document title, plant information, test descriptions, sample-retention period, personnel, signature, and archive stamp are otherwise unchanged.
